summary: The `ansible.builtin.map` filter applies a filter to each item in a sequence or looks up an attribute on each; it's Jinja's builtin map filter.
questions: How do I pull one attribute out of every item in a list?
How do I apply a filter to every item in a list?

answer_card.title: map filter
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.map` applies a filter to a sequence of objects or looks up an attribute on each. It's Jinja's builtin `map` filter.
